Tell me about UK2 Group

source: Tom's own account

UK2 Group is an international web hosting company with offices in UK, US and Ukraine.

I joined as Head of Group Strategy - working across all brands and markets troubleshooting for the CEO.

Key work included:

  • Linked people, products and projects across UK, US, and Ukraine offices
  • Acting Marketing Manager US: rebuilt underperforming US marketing department
  • Business unit turnaround: reversed downward revenue trend in 6 months
  • Managed development of new domain platform (500,000+ customer domains)

Direct answers

  • Midphase (UK2's US hosting unit): restructured two flat-rate plans into tiered accounts with 3, 12 and 24-month pricing and ran an anti-churn programme with free upgrades and added features; ARPU up, customer lifetime extended, the downward revenue trend reversed in 6 months, 8 products launched in 10 months.
  • The domain platform: we had 6 brands using 3 different providers, and in some cases going direct to the registry, each with different APIs, rules and management fees. One platform replaced them.
  • For the domain platform I owned the business case, budget, specifications, contracts and migration strategy.
  • Troubleshooter for the CEO across London, Chicago & Utah offices. Owned strategy across pricing, product and marketing. Diagnosed underperforming brand, created product & ecommerce strategy.
  • Product work at UK2, formally, under the title Head of Group Strategy.
  • Company context: UK2 grew from about 100 to about 200 people while I was there.
  • Scope: in effect head of product for the US parts of the business I worked on.
  • Two product teams at UK2: the group domain platform (business case, budget, specifications, contracts, migration) and product for the US unit, led remotely from London, with pricing in scope[UK2].

source: Tom's own account, direct answers

Tell me about the UK2 marketing role

source: Tom's own account

Rebuilt the underperforming US Marketing department before recruiting a US-based successor (Feb 2009 - Feb 2010).

Created marketing strategy, implemented reporting structure, set and met budget targets. Managed all online and marketing activity across 5 web properties.

Also ran a business unit turnaround in parallel: reduced bounce rate by ~15%, nearly doubled sales conversion, created product roadmap and launched 8 products in 10 months.

The challenge was doing this remotely from the UK, with a team I'd never met in person. Required building trust fast and being very clear about expectations.
